item.title: Canada's Carney called out for 'utilizing' British spelling
item.description:
📝 Canadian language experts are calling on Prime Minister Mark Carney to ditch British spelling in official documents, and 'utilize' Canadian spelling instead. But Canadian English takes from British English in other ways, like using 'ou' in colour, rather than the American 'color'. Why is Canadian English unique.
🔗 Read more: https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj69d89l8l5o
